response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_ambictemp, avg_imgcount, avg_imgcount - (SELECT AVG(avg_imgcount) FROM per) AS imgcount_diff_from_mean FROM per

assumptions.assumption: Inner join on scanenvironment.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry drops environment records with no matching site. Sites with a NULL entrystat form their own NULL group.
The mean of per-status image averages uses all groups, with each counted equally. A status whose imgcount values are all NULL has a NULL average, and AVG skips it, so it is left out of that mean.
